assumptions.statement: The frozen v0.3/H0 relation and corpus are the only faithful PQTC relation control.
assumptions.consequence: Generic upstream examples are never labeled PQTC.

assumptions.statement: Pins, source findings, license gates, and implementation limits in ../landscape are authoritative.
assumptions.consequence: Runners fail on pin or inspected-file hash drift.

assumptions.statement: Upstream-only measurements require the label UPSTREAM_BASELINE_NOT_PQTC.
assumptions.consequence: No upstream claim can qualify a finalist.

assumptions.statement: No hiding construction, transcript theorem, cross-version port, Flock adapter, or EVM verifier is invented in this package.
assumptions.consequence: Unmet gates retain DEFERRED or STOP.
